rows.definition: The explicit Go build tag selecting the experimental V4.1 scalar logit multiplication adapter and its software ABI and deferred physical tests. With the Vulkan tag it selects a separate native archive; combining it with either the indexer or BF16 witness tag is a compile-time error.
rows.distinction: This controls Go source and archive selection, whereas FAK_V41_LOGIT_SCALE_WITNESS controls native symbol compilation and lfakvulkan_v41_logit_scale_witness names the linker input. The tag does not qualify hardware, enable ordinary production capability or remove host-boundary blockers.

rows.definition: The native compile-time define that exposes the experimental scalar logit multiplication C declarations and builds its checked dispatch, optional FloatControls module admission and parser-test entry points into the dedicated witness archive. The Go adapter defines it for its C header declarations.
rows.distinction: This selects native declarations and implementation; the v41_logit_scale_witness Go tag selects the corresponding Go adapter. Its presence is an experimental build identity rather than physical qualification or a trusted production shader-registry promotion.

rows.definition: The exact cgo linker-option token selecting libfakvulkan_v41_logit_scale_witness.a for the scalar witness-tagged Go build. All five Vulkan archive selectors choose this input exclusively for that tag combination, and an ordinary archive lacks the witness-only symbols.
rows.distinction: This names the linker input; it is separate from the Go build tag and native compile-time define. The option alone does not prove which archive bytes were linked: independently reviewed build commands and artifact hashes provide that evidence under immutable-artifact execution.

rows.definition: The read-only native admission predicate for a scalar logit row. It requires the dedicated witness pipeline and its selected-device FloatControls to be available, a positive element count, and ceil(count/64) within that device's X workgroup limit. The Go adapter checks it before allocating the output because this shader has no grid-stride loop.
rows.distinction: This bounds one scalar dispatch shape; it does not execute multiplication, validate input elements, report checkpoint support or establish physical qualification. FAK_V41_LOGIT_SCALE_WITNESS selects native compilation, while this predicate checks the loaded pipeline and requested row length.
